module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  in,
    output reg disc,
    output reg flag,
    output reg err
);
    reg [2:0] cnt;
    reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= 2'b01;
            cnt <= 3'b000;
            disc <= 1'b0;
            flag <= 1'b0;
            err <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            state <= nextstate;
            case (state)
                2'b00: if (in) begin cnt <= 3'b001; nextstate = 2'b01; end
                2'b01: begin
                    if (in) begin cnt <= cnt + 1'b1; end
                    else begin cnt <= 3'b000; nextstate = 2'b10; end
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    if (in) begin cnt <= cnt + 1'b1; end
                    else begin
                        if (cnt == 3'b010) begin nextstate = 2'b00; disc <= 1'b1; end
                        else if (cnt == 3'b011) begin nextstate = 2'b00; flag <= 1'b1; end
                        else if (cnt >= 3'b100) begin nextstate = 2'b00; err <= 1'b1; end
                        else begin nextstate = 2'b00; end
                        cnt <= 3'b000;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input in, output reg disc, output reg flag, output reg err);
  reg [2:0] cnt;
  reg [2:0] st, nx;
  always @(*) begin
    case (st)
      3'd0: if (in) begin nx = 3'd1; flag = 1; end else begin nx = 3'd0; flag = 0; end
      3'd1: if (in) begin nx = 3'd2; end else begin nx = 3'd0; flag = 0; end
      3'd2: if (in) begin nx = 3'd3; end else begin nx = 3'd1; flag = 0; end
      3'd3: if (in) begin nx = 3'd4; end else begin nx = 3'd2; flag = 0; end
      3'd4: if (in) begin nx = 3'd5; end else begin nx = 3'd3; flag = 0; end
      3'd5: if (in) begin nx = 3'd0; disc = 1; end else begin nx = 3'd4; flag = 0; end
      default: nx = 3'd0;
    endcase
    if (cnt == 3'd5 && in) err = 1;
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin st <= 3'd0; cnt <= 3'd0; end
    else begin st <= nx; cnt <= (st == 3'd5 && in) ? 3'd1 : cnt + 3'd1; end
    disc <= 0; flag <= 0; err <= 0;
  end
endmodule
